budget_items.what_was_recorded: Assessed value, appraised value, and negotiated price of the Saliba property, with the negotiated price stated as a percentage below each.
budget_items.quote: the assessed value of the property is 996,900. the appraised value is 1,110,000. negotiated price is $775,000, 22% below assessed value and 29% below appraised value.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net effect of the FY budget adjustments, including tax title increased, comes to a surplus available for appropriation.
budget_items.quote: tax title (increased to $24,000). the net effect of the changes come to a $78,604 surplus available for appropriation.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Adjusted new growth estimate is lower than the annual town meeting estimate by a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: an adjusted estimate to new growth ($18,367 less than annual town meeting estimate)

budget_items.topic: Article B streetlight LED conversion cost and annual streetlight service
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected cost of LED conversion, and the annual amount the town pays for streetlight service.
budget_items.quote: the projected cost of conversion is $65,493. we annually pay approximately $74,300 for streetlight service.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unitil projects an annual savings after LED conversion.
budget_items.quote: until is projecting a savings of $31,000 annual after led conversion.

budget_items.topic: Article B cost of acquiring streetlights from Unitil
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cost to acquire the street lights from Unitil, with conversion, grant and maintenance costs still to be added.
budget_items.quote: the cost of acquiring the street lights from unitil is $87,646, plus there would be subsequent costs

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager recommended appropriating the budget surplus to the special purpose stabilization fund; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: article c, special purpose stabilization. the town manager recommended that the budget surplus be appropriated

budget_items.topic: Article E sewer retained earnings transfer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed move of sewer enterprise retained earnings to the Reserve Capacity Stabilization Fund.
budget_items.quote: article e, an article to move retained earnings of $7,513.66 from sewer enterprise retained earnings

budget_items.topic: Article N earth removal bylaw financial impact
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town may see financial impacts from the bylaw, described as indirect and unpredictable; no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: mr. burney communicated there may be financial impacts to the town as result of the bylaw but are indirect and unpredictable.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Only the Council on Aging Director change would draw on the Salary Reserve Account; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: the only change that would reflect access to monies from the salary reserve account would be the council on aging director position.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Member noted interest costs of borrowing should be counted in overall project costs; no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: dave passios called attention to the interest costs associated with borrowing, which should be considered as part of the overall costs.
